about: ApexNav place-name lexicon for web/g2p.js, checked before the misaki dictionaries. Hand-written in misaki phonemes (docs/VOICE.md, misaki EN_PHONES.md) for names the BART fallback gets wrong. Exact word match, case-sensitive. Each entry must be checked by ear before it ships to users; 'checked' says who did.

Mulholland.checked: agent, from the common pronunciation mul-HOL-and; not yet heard

Tellico.checked: agent, TELL-ih-coh as used in Tellico Plains TN; not yet heard
